build_task_with_define_task: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE task
create_box_with_add_box: call add_box on the TaskCreator to add a box body with specified width and height
position_box_with_set_bottom: chain set_bottom on a body to position it by its bottom Y coordinate
position_box_with_set_left: chain set_left on a body to position it by its left X coordinate
finalize_task_with_update_task: call update_task to set body references, spatial relationships, and a task description
